root.label: Jamie Raskin seeks data center NDA information

events.label: Jamie Raskin seeks data center NDA information

slots.name: date letters sent
slots.sentence: Rep. Jamie Raskin (D., Md.), the top Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee, sent letters to Amazon, Alphabet’s Google, Meta Platforms and Oracle on Tuesday seeking information on their nondisclosure agreements with government officials related to data-center build-outs, The Wall Street Journal reported.
